children.text: Led Angular 20 micro-frontends for credit-scoring and hotlisting products using Nx, Module Federation, Signals, and shared libraries. Developed Python APIs and REST integrations with SQL-backed services.
Built WebSocket dashboards for large datasets and asynchronous operations. Partnered with Product Owners and UX teams to scope requirements and manage UI delivery.
Co-developed Jira, Figma & Confluence MCP tools; contributed to PR quality/security gates, Docker deployments, and Grafana observability.

Led end-to-end delivery of fixed-income pricing and portfolio optimization applications. Designed REST API contracts linking Angular interfaces, Python quantitative services, and third-party calculation engines.
Worked on server-side concurrency, Kafka streams, and WebSocket synchronization. Built Plotly and Highcharts dashboards for real-time data and long-running computations.
Partnered with business stakeholders to replace kdb+ and Excel workflows; led architecture, roadmaps, code reviews, and mentoring in Docker environments.

Independently owned Angular modernization for commercial banking and ACH transaction workflows. Debugged legacy .NET behavior to understand business flows and integrate revamped interfaces with existing services.
Built reusable design-system components with WCAG-aligned accessibility and improved frontend performance across banking modules.
Developed Node.js-backed functionality alongside modular Angular applications for enterprise procurement. Built an in-house Angular component library with reusable design-system patterns.
Led and mentored engineers on maintainable architecture, shared components, and consistent delivery practices.

Delivered full-stack functionality across services and frontend interfaces for telecom modernization. Wrote Python scripts and web scrapers to automate data retrieval and repetitive engineering tasks.
Worked with containerized services written in multiple languages in Docker-based environments.

projects.title: RAG Deep Dive
projects.summary: A hands-on Python project comparing direct Gemini inference, explicit Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and LCEL-based RAG. Explores document embeddings, vector search, retrieved context, and LangChain workflow composition.

children.text: Built a small RAG demonstration to understand how external knowledge is supplied to an LLM and how orchestration differs between explicit Python code and LangChain Expression Language.

projects.title: AI Agents Under the Hood
projects.summary: Two Python examples comparing LangChain-managed orchestration with an explicit tool-calling loop.

children.text: Understanding agent orchestration beyond framework abstractions.

Explored AI agent orchestration through two practical Python implementations: a Gemini-powered job-search agent using LangChain and Tavily, and an explicit ReAct-style tool-calling loop with custom tools. An educational reference for how LLMs use external tools, maintain context, process observations, and produce final responses.
and Tavily Search to discover AI engineering opportunities in Bengaluru. LangChain manages tool execution and returns a structured answer with source URLs.

with custom Python tools for product-price lookup and discount calculations. Manually dispatches tool calls, appends observations to message history, and stops on a final answer or an iteration limit.
Tool observations feed back into the next model decision.
Frameworks accelerate implementation. Understanding the underlying agent loop enables better engineering decisions.
Both examples use LangChain interfaces with Gemini; the second makes orchestration explicit.

projects.title: System Design & Architecture Field Guide
projects.summary: From architectural fundamentals to real-world system design. A 39-page guide for learning, revision, and HLD/LLD interview preparation.

children.text: A practical study and revision guide to scalable, reliable, and maintainable software systems. Explore architectural patterns, distributed data, consistency, event-driven architectures, and the trade-offs behind each design decision.

Worked Railway Booking and Banking Transfer designs connect the concepts to concurrency, failure recovery, ledger consistency, and idempotency. Architecture diagrams and mock HLD/LLD interviews help developers learn the foundations and experienced engineers revisit them.
Great architecture starts with understanding requirements and making deliberate trade-offs.
functional and non-functional requirements, constraints, CAP, and distributed data strategies.

railway seat reservations and banking transfers, with concurrency, reliable transactions, and recovery in context.
